newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga warns that firearms given to opposition United National Party (UNP) lawmakers for security reasons will be taken back.

A UNP lawmaker surrendered to a magistrate on Thursday in connection with a shooting incident where a ruling People's Alliance (PA) coalition candidate in the March 21 local poll was wounded. A UNP MP and a former mayor are already in custody over last month's killing of a PA lawmaker.
Security forces attack Tamil Tiger (LTTE) bases in eastern Mullaitivu jungles in a joint operation codenamed "Thrividha Seraya".

UNP MP Pradeep Hapangama to be produced before Colombo magistrate in connection with shooting incident in Kelaniya, a Colombo suburb, in which a PA canidate contesting the March 21 election was wounded.
Joint operation by Sri Lankan forces destroys key Tiger rebel bases in east.
An LTTE international co-ordinator from Britain arrested with 22 passports by police in Seeduwa, north of Colombo.
A UNP candidate for Kelaniya, George Perera remanded until March 25 after Wednesday's shooting where a PA caniddate was wounded.
